translations.web: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.
translations.bsb: Still others were saying, “We have borrowed money to pay the king’s tax on our fields and vineyards.
translations.kjv: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king's tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.
